description: Script for testing 'git p4' interactions with files containing wildcards and special characters, including add, submit, clone, modify, rename, delete, and keyword scrubbing operations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a series of commands.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks preconditions for running certain tests, such as environment or tools availability.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to run after tests complete.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Removes temporary git repositories or cleans the environment.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a specified file.
